title.zh: MultiversX在漏洞事件停链后重启，但Kraken仍禁止EGLD新交易
title.en: MultiversX restarts after exploit halt, but Kraken still bars new EGLD trades

current_state.zh:
MultiversX表示其主网已于9月24日（周四）恢复出块，距离因漏洞事件而停止网络进展约五天，其技术账号@CodeMultiversX称恢复升级已部署完成。截至同日（9月24日）核查时，Kraken的事件页面仍将EGLD标记为仅可撤单交易，充值与提现暂停，并且没有给出恢复时间。

链的重启本身并未恢复EGLD的交易或将资产通过Kraken转出的能力：@CodeMultiversX警告称，在部分交易所完成自身重启流程期间，交易、充值和提现可能还会暂停数日，并建议用户查看交易所的官方更新。

Kraken的事件时间线早于此次网络停摆——该交易所最早于9月16日报告EGLD资金网关可能出现延迟，并于9月19日将EGLD交易对转为仅可撤单，因此仅凭日期无法确定该交易所最初问题及其升级的原因。仅可撤单允许客户撤销已有订单，但禁止下新单和成交；此外，MultiversX的声明并未明确具体的停止与重启时间。
current_state.en: MultiversX brought its mainnet back online after a roughly five-day exploit-related halt following a recovery upgrade, while Kraken continued to restrict EGLD to cancel-only trading with deposits and withdrawals paused.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: MultiversX brought its mainnet back online after a roughly five-day exploit-related halt following a recovery upgrade, while Kraken continued to restrict EGLD to cancel-only trading with deposits and withdrawals paused.
updates.detailed_summary_en: MultiversX brought its mainnet back online after a roughly five-day exploit-related halt following a recovery upgrade, while Kraken continued to restrict EGLD to cancel-only trading with deposits and withdrawals paused.
updates.background_zh: MultiversX于9月19日表示，针对虚拟机原子性问题的未遂攻击导致了无效状态变更，并促使网络暂停推进；9月24日的技术更新称工程团队已完成恢复检查。MultiversX于2020年上线主网，其原生代币EGLD（“eGold”，前身为ERD）用于质押、奖励验证者以及在网络上存储和转移价值。
updates.background_en: MultiversX said on Sept. 19 that an attempted exploit of a virtual-machine atomicity issue had caused invalid state changes and prompted a pause in network progression; the Sept. 24 technical update said engineering had completed recovery checks. MultiversX launched its mainnet in 2020 and its native cryptocurrency, EGLD ("eGold"), formerly ERD, is used for staking, rewarding validators, and storing and transferring value on the network.
updates.market_impact_zh: EGLD在交易所层面的流动性目前被分割：在Kraken限制新订单并暂停EGLD充提的情况下，交易与资金流动被限制在其他交易所以及MultiversX称已恢复的链上活动中。尚未解决的变量是Kraken何时恢复交易与充提，因为其公告决定了EGLD能否进出该平台。
updates.market_impact_en: EGLD's exchange-level liquidity is currently segmented: with Kraken restricting new orders and pausing EGLD deposits and withdrawals, trading and funding flows are confined to other venues and to on-chain activity, which MultiversX says has resumed. The unresolved variable is when Kraken restores trading and funding, since its notice governs whether EGLD can move in and out of that venue.
